scalars.scalar_value: Experience delivering and handling Compressed Gas Cylinders.
Experience driving delivery vehicles (vans and/or 25,500 GVW delivery truck) and using a lift gate to deliver merchandise in busy pedestrian/bicycle traffic areas.

items.item_text: Required to hold a valid California driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program
Current CA Commercial C license with hazardous materials endorsement.
Experience driving delivery vehicles (vans and/or 25,500 GVW delivery truck) and using a lift gate to deliver merchandise in busy pedestrian/bicycle traffic areas.
Experience delivering and handling Compressed Gas Cylinders.

Experience handling and operating powered and non-powered material handling equipment (e.g., gas and electric forklifts, electric stock pickers, electric pallet jacks, hand trucks, flat carts, mail tubs and cages etc.).
Experience delivering and driving in a campus environment.

Experience complying with route delivery schemes based on freight volume, geographical location, traffic, and time restrictions; as well as experience using forklifts to load and unload delivery vehicles.
Experience with inventory procedures specific to the University.

Under supervision, incumbents perform the duties of the series wherein the major responsibility is to deliver packages, freight, documents, mail and or a variety of materials to University departments. Deliveries are made by using a wide assortment of material handling equipment and delivery vehicles.
20% - Customer Service and Teamwork

Communication skills and comprehension to read and follow maps, policies, instructions on hazardous materials shipping requirements and regulatory guidelines; packing slips, shipping orders, memos, etc.
Knowledge of Materials of Trade and Placarding regulations.
Writing and printing skills to annotate delivery receipts, shipping memos, etc.
Knowledge of campus geography and delivery locations.
Understanding of and skill to perform basic mathematical calculations ensuring accurate results.Knowledge of Safety procedures and appropriate handling of dangerous goods.
Ability to adhere to campus policies, procedures and the Principles of Community.
Interpersonal and customer service skills communication in a pleasant, tactful, and effective manner in person or on the phone with a wide variety of individuals.

Ability to effectively communicate and work within cross-organizational teams, work collaboratively with individuals and groups from a diverse variety of backgrounds and organizational levels, to actively listen to other's ideas, to be inclusive of other's needs, to contribute effectively and to build consensus whenever possible.
Ability to work independently (self-starter) and efficiently under tight deadlines while remaining cordial and producing desired result.
Ability to work with and transport sensitive materials (i.e. paychecks, patient billings, W2's, etc.
Ability to provide exceptional internal/external customer service while maintaining a high level of ethics.
